name: Godavari Drugs Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, Godavari Drugs Ltd manufactures and sale of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients and their intermediates[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of Manufacturing APIs, drug intermediaries, and fine chemicals and caters to the global Life Science Industry. It has an active Loan License and Contract Manufacturing tie-ups with multinational companies for APIs and drug intermediates

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 14.3 days to 10.6 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 3.44% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 12.5% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -4.31%
